description:
## Outcome

Two later readiness reviews decide whether to create separate implementation tasks for Winget and `homebrew/core`.

## Work

1. Evaluate Winget after Windows packaging and signing are stable.
2. Evaluate `homebrew/core` after stable repeatable releases, Linux support, tap history, and sufficient use.
3. Record evidence, unmet criteria, maintenance cost, owner, and security requirements.
4. Create a bounded follow-up issue only for a ready channel.
5. Record a measurable next review trigger for a channel that is not ready.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Winget and `homebrew/core` have independent decisions.
- [ ] Decisions cite current channel requirements and project evidence.
- [ ] A positive decision creates one bounded follow-up issue.
- [ ] A negative decision states measurable review triggers.

## Tests

Validate decision templates and created dependency links.

## Non-goals

Do not submit to a channel only to close this review.
title: Evaluate later Winget and homebrew-core publication
